title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 14. Is concerned about the increasing use of the EU GHRSR across the world; emphasises that unanimity voting must remain the norm in the field of foreign policy and human rights and opposes qualified majority voting for decisions on the GHRSR; supports the possibility of imposing targeted anti-corruption sanctions within the EU framework;
